Text-led workflow slide one introduces room capture: photos, measurements, openings, fixed elements, routines, and constraints.
Text-led workflow slide two, “Research behind the conversation,” explains that inspiration and reactions remain primary while cited field guides add research depth.
Text-led workflow slide three describes revising a chosen direction while preserving approved room and resident decisions.
Text-led workflow slide four describes placing a specific product in the current room and checking its measured footprint separately.
Text-led workflow slide five turns current sources, reliable dimensions, alternatives, budget, and phases into an actionable plan.
